summary_md: **. ([@stepperAPEX](https://x.com/stepperAPEX/status/2116303984172642364))** releases **f16acc** (MIT, Triton), which reaches near-FP32 accuracy for FP16 matmuls at full tensor rate on stock GeForce cards. It sums 32-product chunks in FP16 and adds them in FP32, redoing overflowing tiles. On an RTX 4060 Ti it hits 65 TFLOPS vs 43–47 for cuBLAS, and Qwen2.5-1.5B prefill runs 1.22–1.24x faster with unchanged perplexity. A two-line `enable()` patches every FP16 `nn.Linear`. The thread credits ooples/AiDotNet.Tensors for the idea and notes a Windows flash-attention fallback fixed in torch 2.14 ([steppergg/f16acc](https://github.com/steppergg/f16acc)).
